label: STRESS · new evidence
text: In a practice outage, the team disconnects the central sign-in service. Staff with permission can still open the protected local pickup list by following the written offline procedure. After the system returns, they merge the paper changes into the central list. No differences remain in the sample checked during this practice run. The results cover the desk tested, trained staff and daytime work. Explain whether this supports the limits you set for the fallback, and what these results still do not show.
